name: biostrat_reality_loop
description: MCP Task — Biostrat Reality Loop. Multi-step agentic workflow: parse → normalize → resolve → context-check → falsify → rule → seal. 6 stages, 4 required tools, 2 required prompts, 4 required resources, 1 governance verdict. Encodes the Arif-spec reality loop as a governed MCP task.

task_definition.trigger: Any biostratigraphic claim, well report, sample table, or fossil list requiring governed interpretation
task_definition.output: Governed biostratigraphic ruling with truth-class labels, confidence tier, per-gate evidence, and immutable evidence contract

stages.name: Intake
stages.description: Receive free text, report paragraph, well note, sample table, or fossil list
stages.action: Accept input text from user or upstream agent

stages.name: Parse
stages.description: Extract biozones, GDE events, fossil groups, lithology, and depth information from free text using regex-based deterministic parser

output_schema.biozones: [{zone, scheme, age_top_ma, age_base_ma, confidence, source_span, evidence_tag}]
output_schema.lithology_class: string (SAND_PRONE, SHALE_PRONE, CARBONATE, COAL_CARBONACEOUS, HETEROLITHIC, etc.)

stages.name: Normalize + Resolve
stages.description: Normalize biozone names to canonical form (NN5 → Martini NN5) and resolve to calibrated age brackets
stages.action: For each parsed biozone, call geox_biostrat_nn_age. Apply GDE event normalization from resource.

output_schema.resolved_zones: [{zone, scheme, discipline, age_top_ma, age_base_ma, epoch, calibration, not_a_radiometric_age, confidence}]

stages.name: Context-Check
stages.description: Test each resolved biozone against lithology, depositional environment, and regional framework for physical plausibility
stages.action: For each biozone, call geox_biostrat_ruling_check with lithology and environment from parse stage

stages.name: Falsify
stages.description: Run full 8-gate Popperian falsification test against the strongest claim derived from observations
stages.action: Call geox_biostrat_falsify with all available context

stages.name: Ruling + Seal
stages.description: Synthesize all stage outputs into final governed ruling. Assign confidence tier. Produce evidence contract.
stages.action: Compose ruling from all prior stages. Apply 5-tier confidence schema (HIGH/MED/MED-LOW/LOW/UNUSABLE). Assign truth-class labels to every element.

Δ_CLARITY.description: Six distinct stages. No stage collapses into another. Each output labelled with truth class.
Δ_CLARITY.enforcement: Stage output schemas are strict — missing fields = stage incomplete

Ω_HUMILITY.description: Every ruling carries confidence tier. FALSIFIED is valid output — science advances by elimination.
Ω_HUMILITY.enforcement: Maximum confidence for biostrat claims: 0.85 (F7). Falsification confidence: up to 0.90.

Ψ_VITALITY.description: Contradictions surfaced at stages 4 and 5. Never suppressed to produce 'clean' result.
Ψ_VITALITY.enforcement: Stage 6 output must include unresolved_contradictions even if overall verdict is PASS.

POPPER_RULE.description: Any single FALSIFIED gate at Stage 5 → overall FALSIFIED regardless of other stages.
POPPER_RULE.enforcement: Stage 6 must not override Stage 5 falsification. Falsified claims are falsified — period.

constitutional_alignment.F1_AMANAH: Task is read-only. No mutation of input data. Output is a ruling, not an edit.
constitutional_alignment.F2_TRUTH: Every stage carries evidence_for and evidence_against. Fabrication is impossible — all outputs traceable to stage inputs.
constitutional_alignment.F4_CLARITY: 6-stage structure enforced. Stage outputs are structured JSON, never collapsed prose.
constitutional_alignment.F11_AUDIT: Full audit trail: stages executed, tools called, prompts used, resources accessed, timestamp.
